about: Real-hull half-breadths written by scripts/blender/hull_lib.py; read by scripts/qa/check-layout.mjs. three.js axes: x stern->bow, y up, z athwartships. halfBreadth[i][j] is the inner half-width of the shell at x[i], y[j] (0 = outside the hull). keel = lowest hull point on the centreline, deck = main deck height and half-width at the side.
